lines.text: > [* [Strategy]] ([from Greek] [στρατηγία] [/ stratēgia], "troop leadership; office of general, command, generalship"[. [戦略#6aabe50d0000000000f5e28a]1]) is a general plan to achieve one or more long-term or overall goals under conditions of uncertainty.[. [戦略#6aabe5150000000000f5e28b]2] In the sense of the "art of the general", which included several subsets of skills including [military tactics], [siegecraft], [logistics] etc., the term came into use in the [6th century] C.E. in [Eastern Roman terminology], and was translated into Western vernacular languages only in the [18th century]. From then until the 20th century, the word "strategy" came to denote "a comprehensive way to try to pursue political ends, including the threat or actual use of force, in a dialectic of wills" in a military conflict, in which both adversaries interact.[. [戦略#6aabe56f0000000000f5e28c]3]
